title: Account locked after wrong attempts
symptom: Account locked after several wrong password attempts
user_description: It says my account is locked after I typed my password wrong a few times. I'm sure I'm typing it right now!

options.text: Create a brand new account for her
options.why: Unnecessary and messy. It duplicates the user and loses her settings and access.

options.text: Verify her identity, unlock the account following the process, and ask if she changed her password recently
options.why: Lockouts protect accounts from guessing, so confirm identity before unlocking. Asking about a recent change often reveals why the old password keeps being tried.

options.text: Turn off the lockout rule for the whole company
options.why: Removes protection for everyone to fix one user. Never weaken security for convenience.

options.text: Tell her to keep trying until it unlocks
options.why: More attempts can extend the lockout and signal an attack to the security system.

hints: Why does an account lock itself after several wrong attempts?
What do you need to confirm before you unlock it?
real_world_tip: Ask if the user has the password saved on a phone or another PC. Old saved passwords are a common cause of repeat lockouts.
